caption: The drawing features two views of a woven straw hat depicted in shades of tan and light brown. The top view, positioned in the upper half of the image, shows the hat as a flat circular object with a concentric pattern of braided straw. Around the crown, there is a decorative geometric pattern outlined in black, resembling alternating rectangular notches or tabs. The side view, shown in the lower half of the image, presents the same hat from an angled perspective, highlighting the dome-shaped crown and wide, flat brim. The same black outlined geometric decorative elements encircle the crown near the base, aligning with the pattern seen in the top view. The background is a plain, light beige color. The artist's name and date are inscribed in the lower right corner.
title: Hat
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
